source_text: Uixdum enim biduum fluxerat, et ecce Marianum et Iacobum carissimos nostros sua palma quaerebat. Nec ut aliis in locis unus hoc aut alius stationarius miles agebat, sed centurionum uiolenta manus et improba multitudo sic ad uillam, quae nos habebat, quasi ad famosam sedem fidei conuolarat. Exoptata nobis incursio! O felix et digna exultatione trepidatio! Siquidem ad nos uentum est propter hoc tantum, ut dei dignationem Mariani et Iacobi iustus sanguis expleret. Uix hoc in loco possumus, fratres dilectissimi, gaudia cumulata frenare, qui alios ante biduum ad ipsum passionis exitum a nostris amplexibus miseramus, alios adhuc nobiscum futuros martyras habebamus. Quos cum iam matura diuinae dignationis hora fortius quaerit, nos etiam aliqua fraternae gloriae parte perstrinxit, et pertrahebamur a Muguis in Cirtensem coloniam. Sequebantur autem carissimi nobis et ad palmam passionis electi, quos et nostri amor ducebat et Christi iam matura dignatio. Ita miro modo et inmaculato pergendi ordine sequebantur illi qui fuerant antecessuri. Denique illis non fuit longa dilatio; namque dum nos exultantius adhortantur, se quoque Christianos esse liberiore gaudio prodiderunt. Mox interrogati, cum in fortissima nominis confessione perstarent, deducuntur in carcerem.
orientation: The narrator tells how Marian and James were seized with the brothers at the farmhouse and hauled toward Cirta.
pass_a_gloss: For scarcely yet a two-day period had flowed by, and behold their own palm was seeking Marian and James our dearest ones. And not as in other places one or another stationed soldier was doing this, but a violent band of centurions and a shameless crowd had rushed together to the farmhouse which was holding us, as if to a famous seat of faith. O longed-for attack for us! O happy alarm and worthy of exultation! For indeed it was come to us for this only, that the righteous blood of Marian and James might fulfill the gracious favor of God. Scarcely in this place are we able, brothers dearly beloved, to bridle our heaped-up joys, we who had sent others before two days from our embraces to the very outcome of suffering, and were holding others still with us as future martyrs. When the now ripe hour of divine gracious favor seeks them more strongly, it has touched us also with some share of brotherly glory, and we were being dragged from Muguas to the Cirtensian colony. But there were following those dear to us and chosen for the palm of suffering, whom both love of us was leading and the now ripe gracious favor of Christ. So in a wonderful manner and with unstained order of marching those were following who were going to go before. Finally for them there was not a long delay; for while they encourage us more exultantly, they disclosed with freer joy that they too are Christians. Soon, when questioned, since they were standing firm in a most brave confession of faith of the Name, they are led down into prison.

pass_b_english: Barely two days had passed, and their own palm was seeking our dearest Marian and James. In other places one guard on duty or another does this work. Here a violent band of centurions and a shameless crowd rushed together to the country house that held us, as if to a famous seat of faith. It was a raid we had longed for! O happy trembling, worthy of exultation! For they came to us for this alone, that the righteous blood of Marian and James might fulfill God's gracious favor.

At this point, dearest brothers, we can scarcely curb our heaped joys. Two days earlier we had sent some from our embrace straight to the very end of their passion, and we still had others with us as future martyrs. When the now ripe hour of divine gracious favor seeks them more urgently, it touched even us with some share of brotherly glory, and we were being dragged from Muguis to the colony of Cirta. Those dear to us and chosen for the palm of passion were following us, for both love for us was leading them and Christ's now ripe gracious favor was leading them. So in a wonderful way and with unstained order of march, those who were to go ahead were following behind. Their wait was not long. While they encourage us with still greater exultation, they revealed with still freer joy that they too are Christians. Soon they were questioned, and as they were standing firm in the most brave confession of faith of the Name, they are led into prison.
